wizardpedia.entry.about.title: About Wizardpedia
wizardpedia.entry.about.1: The Wizardpedia book is a living, in-game catalog.
wizardpedia.entry.about.2: Its pages list entries contributed by datapacks and by provider mods.
wizardpedia.entry.about.3: Locked entries are greyed out until their provider marks them discovered.
wizardpedia.entry.datapack.title: Datapack Entries
wizardpedia.entry.datapack.1: Any datapack can add entries — no code required.
wizardpedia.entry.datapack.2: Add JSON files under data/<namespace>/wizardpedia/categories/ and /entries/.
wizardpedia.entry.datapack.3: Run /reload to rescan; a malformed file is skipped whole.
wizardpedia.entry.provider.title: Provider Mods
wizardpedia.entry.provider.1: Mods can feed the catalog over the wizardpedia:catalog channel.
wizardpedia.entry.provider.2: No compile-time dependency is needed — packets follow a documented wire format.
wizardpedia.entry.provider.3: Provider entries win id conflicts and may override the locked flag.
